content: Can someone explain to me what exactly "Too many targets for <some eliminator>" means? I seem to run into it with some reliability any time I try to use or create a more 'exotic' custom eliminator, and it's not a terribly informative error message; I'm not even sure where I would look it up if I wanted to dig into the code that generates it myself.
It means you're trying to induct on too many things at once

Sure, but syntactically speaking I'm almost always targeting a single variable. Presumably that's not what's happening under the hood, but my confusion is precisely figuring out what other things are being inducted on, and if there's anything I can do about it.
